title: Iterator Service State
description: Runs a nested pipeline once per item. Iteration you can see in the board. (Runtimes: browser, node, python, cpp; IDs: iterator)

itemsFrom.description: Dotted path to the array in the input; the input itself by default

limit.description: Take at most this many items. 0 = all

lastItems.description: Read-only: how many the last pass iterated

lastFailed.description: Read-only: how many of those threw
